sentence: This project builds materials inspired by living organisms, including building blocks that stop assembling at a set size and materials that move like living cells.
This project studies how the folding of chromosomes in the nucleus changes with temperature in the developing gonads of painted turtles.
This project supports a conference on financial cryptography, which studies digital cash, electronic finance, privacy and cryptography.
This project uses machine learning and deep learning to find better ways to decode existing codes and to invent new families of codes.
This project tests whether computational electrical field models can predict how efficiently a roll-to-roll process makes aligned polymer nanofibers.
This project tests whether carefully controlled mineral formation can create barriers in porous coastal limestone that restrict underground water movement.
This project works on making quantum computers reliable by finding and fixing errors in them faster than the errors occur.
This project creates AI resources and a curriculum for a school district, and studies how a lasting research partnership can be built to do this.
This project uses computer calculations and machine learning to find which high entropy alloys hold nitrate best when nitrate is turned into ammonia.
This project studies barnacles that attach to sea turtles and whales, using genetic tags to trace how their ways of attaching evolved.
This project studies a small quantum sensor that uses spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride and works without cryogenic cooling.
This project builds ways to read brain activity without surgery so people with upper limb impairments can control a prosthetic arm to reach and grasp.
This project builds tools to separate and analyze the molecules in complex mixtures, with a focus on dissolved organic matter.
